questions.question_text: Calculate the value of the house, in 10 years time, on January 1st 2024. Give your answer correct to the nearest hundred dollars.
Calculate the whole number of years, from January 1st 2014, it takes for the value of the house to exceed one million dollars.
Calculate the percentage change in the value of the house when it increases from $230 000 to $1 000 000.
At what time does the family arrive at the mountain resort?
Calculate the average speed of the journey.
Calculate the cost of the fuel used during the journey.
Calculate the total cost of the cable car tickets and the lunches for the family.
Calculate the average cost per person of the whole day trip.
Write down the inequality shown by the number line.
Solve the inequality f(x) > 0.
Solve the equation x^2 + 4x + 2 = 0. Give your answers correct to 2 decimal places.
Find, in terms of p and q, BD.
Find, in terms of p and q, AE.
Find the co-ordinates of E.
Find the equation of the straight line which passes through A and E. Give your answer in the form ax + by = d where a, b and d are integers.
Find the median and the quartiles of the geography test marks.
Find the mean mark for each subject.
Find the equation of the linear regression line, giving s in terms of g.
Use the equation in part (c) to predict the science mark when the geography mark is 54.
Explain briefly why the answer to part (d)(i) may not be reliable.

Find the zeros of f(x).
Find the co-ordinates of the local maximum point.
Find the range of f(x).

A, B and C lie on a circle, centre O. The obtuse angle AOB = (6x + 2)° and angle ACB = (2x + 19)°. Find the value of x.
AB and CD are parallel. AX = 6 cm, BX = 5 cm and CX = 3 cm. The area of triangle CXD = 5.1 cm^2. Calculate the area of triangle AXB.
Calculate the volume of the prism.
Calculate the total surface area of the prism.
The piece of cake has a mass of 160 g. It is cut from a circular cake. Calculate the mass of the circular cake. Give your answer in kilograms.
Use graphical methods to solve these equations. Use -2 <= x <= 4 in each part and sketch your graphs. x^3 = 3 - x
Use graphical methods to solve these equations. Use -2 <= x <= 4 in each part and sketch your graphs. x^2 - 2x - 3 = log(x + 2)
Calculate angle BCV. Show that it rounds to 63.06° correct to 4 significant figures.
Calculate the distance LV.
Calculate the shortest distance from V to BC.
Calculate the area of triangle BCV.

Calculate an estimate of the mean reaction time.
On the grid, draw a histogram to show the information in the table.
X is rolled. Write down the probability that the number on the top face is odd.
X is rolled. Write down the probability that the number on the top face is not 1.
The two dice are rolled and the numbers on the top faces are noted. Find the probability that both numbers are 1.
The two dice are rolled and the numbers on the top faces are noted. Find the probability that at least one of the numbers is 1.
The two dice are rolled and the numbers on the top faces are noted. Find the probability that the product of the two numbers is even.
Calculate the angle between the planes ABTU and ABCD.
Calculate AT.
